---
title: "Personal Dataset Project - NZ Health issues by Demographic"
format: pdf
Author: Leo Powdrell
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Load data
health_total <- read.csv(file.choose())

# 2. Filter, categorize, and build the subset
health_subset <- health_total %>%
  # Remove suppressed values to keep data clean
  filter(is.na(flag_for_publishing) | flag_for_publishing != "S") %>%
  mutate(
    # Categorize the Demographic and Geographic Breakdown Types
    breakdown_type = case_when(
      group == "Total" ~ "National Total",
      str_detect(group, "\\|") ~ "Geography (Region)",
      str_detect(group, "Quintile") ~ "Socioeconomic Deprivation",
      group %in% c("Māori", "Pacific", "Asian", "European/Other") ~ "Ethnicity (Racial)",
      group %in% c("Disabled", "Non-disabled") ~ "Disability Status",
      TRUE ~ "Age Group"
    )
  ) %>%
  # Select only the necessary columns for my visualizations
  select(
    indicator = short.description,
    population,
    year,
    breakdown_type,
    group,
    total,
    total.low.CI,
    total.high.CI,
    male,
    female,
    estimated.number
  )

# 3. Check the size and contents of the new dataset
dim(health_subset)
head(health_subset)
```


```{r}

shared_order <- c(
  "Daily smokers",
  "Daily vaping",
  "Self-rated health - poor",
  "Psychological distress - high or very high",
  "Hazardous drinking pattern (total population)",
  "Cannabis use - past 12 months"
  
)

health_subset <- health_subset %>%
  mutate(indicator = factor(indicator, levels = shared_order))

health_subset %>%
  filter(
    year == 2024,
    breakdown_type == "Ethnicity (Racial)", 
    indicator %in% c(
      "Daily smokers",
      "Daily vaping",
      "Hazardous drinking pattern (total population)",
      "Psychological distress - high or very high",
      "Self-rated health - poor",
      "Cannabis use - past 12 months"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = total, y = fct_rev(indicator), color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(
    title = "Health & Addiction Disparities by Ethnicity (2024)",
    subtitle = "Prevalence (%) among NZ adults",
    x = "Prevalence (%)",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Ethnicity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

health_subset %>%
  filter(
    group %in% c("Quintile 1", "Quintile 5"),
    indicator %in% c(
      "Daily smokers",
      "Daily vaping",
      "Psychological distress - high or very high",
      "Self-rated health - poor",
      "Hazardous drinking pattern (total population)",
      "Cannabis use - past 12 months"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = total, color = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~indicator, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Quintile 1" = "#2b8cbe", "Quintile 5" = "#e34a33"),
    labels = c("Quintile 1 (Least Deprived)", "Quintile 5 (Most Deprived)")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "The Deprivation Gap Over Time (2011–2024)",
    subtitle = "Comparing least vs. most socioeconomically deprived neighbourhoods",
    x = "Survey Year",
    y = "Prevalence (%)",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
